author.zh: 加夫列尔·加西亚·马尔克斯

origin.zh: 墨西哥城（哥伦比亚作家）

review.en: Seven generations of the Buendía family in the town of Macondo, from its founding to its end, told in a calm voice that treats miracles and massacres alike. García Márquez folds a continent’s history of wars, companies and forgetting into one household. The repeating names can blur, and that blur is part of its design.
review.zh: 布恩迪亚家族七代人在马孔多小镇的故事，从建镇写到终结，叙述口吻平静，奇迹与屠杀一视同仁。加西亚·马尔克斯把一片大陆的战争、公司与遗忘折进一个家族。反复出现的名字容易让人混淆，而这种混淆本身就是设计的一部分。
